verdict.rationale: Notte is API-first. It documents a Bearer-authenticated API reference covering sessions, scraping and agents, and sessions are explicitly 'controlled programmatically'. Functions deploy as API endpoints, and the MCP server and CLI expose sessions, page interaction, fetching and script-building to agents. However, nothing states that the API matches the console UI feature-for-feature, and the probe found no published OpenAPI spec. missing for 10: explicit API/UI parity statement, documented API coverage of vaults/identities/profiles/templates/replays, machine-readable OpenAPI spec, independent hands-on corroboration of parity.
